sections.title: Lenovo ThinkPad X1
content: Con un procesador que alcanza los 5.2 GHz y hasta 32GB de RAM, el Lenovo ThinkPad X1 maneja tareas pesadas.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 1790 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: POWERFUL PERFORMANCE: The Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon features the Ultra 7 255U processor with speeds up to 5.2GHz and 12MB cache, ensuring smooth multitasking and smart AI optimization. This X1 Carbon gen 13 laptop comes with 32GB DDR5 RAM for fast processing and a 1TB SSD PCIe for ultra-fast storage. Built for business professionals, students, and remote workers.

IMMERSIVE TOUCH DISPLAY: Enjoy an immersive viewing experience with the Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Touchscreen FHD+ 14-inch (1920x1200) IPS display, delivering crisp visuals and accurate colors. The Integrated Intel Graphics enhances performance for streaming, presentations, and daily computing. Whether for business, school, or entertainment, this 14-inch laptop is optimized for clarity, brightness, and productivity, making it perfect for students and professionals.

KEYBOARD & CONNECTIVITY: The Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon features 2 x USB-C (Thunderbolt 4), 2 x USB-A 3.2 Gen 1 (USB 5Gbps, 1x always on), 1 x HDMI 2.1 (up to 4K/60Hz), 1 x Audio jack (3.5mm), Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 5.3, Fingerprint Reader, Backlit Keyboard, FHD 1080p + IR Webcam with Privacy Shutter.
WARRANTY & DURABILITY: The Lenovo ThinkPad X1 is backed by a 1-Year Lenovo Warranty & 1-Year Oem genuine Limited Warranty, ensuring peace of mind. See the product description for details.

sections.title: Dell XPS 13
content: -Pantalla infinita- y brillante, este dispositivo transforma cualquier contenido visual en una experiencia inmersiva.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 1160 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: 【Ultimate On-Device AI Performance & Power】Meet the new Dell XPS 13 9345 laptop, the first Copilot+ PC powered by the Snapdragon X Elite. This 12-core beast with a 45 TOPS NPU delivers desktop-class responsiveness for heavy multitasking and professional creation. Enjoy seamless AI acceleration, lightning-fast app launches, and unprecedented efficiency. Your new XPS laptop isn't just smart—it's a powerhouse designed to think ahead.

【Industry-Leading Multi-Day Battery Life】Engineered to be the longest-lasting in its class, this Dell XPS 13 lets you work, stream, and create for a full day and beyond on a single charge. Tackle back-to-back meetings, cross-country flights, and demanding workloads without ever hunting for an outlet. This XPS 13 laptop delivers the exceptional, all-day power that mobile professionals need.

【Vibrant FHD+ InfinityEdge Display with 120Hz】 Experience a brilliant 13.4-inch screen that brings your work and entertainment to life. The sharp FHD+ (1920x1200) resolution, combined with a buttery-smooth 120Hz refresh rate and ultra-slim InfinityEdge borders, makes everything from scrolling documents to streaming videos look incredibly fluid. With 500 nits of peak brightness, it stays clear and vivid, even in well-lit rooms or by a window.

【Sleek, Premium Design with Advanced Connectivity】Experience the future in your hands with our thinnest and lightest XPS laptop ever. Crafted from CNC aluminum, it combines unmatched portability with robust durability. Stay on the cutting edge with Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4 for rock-solid connections, and utilize two versatile USB4 ports (40Gbps) for charging, data transfer, and connecting dual 4K monitors.

【Enhanced Productivity & Security Features】This business-ready Dell XPS laptop is built to protect and perform. A seamless glass haptic touchpad and backlit keyboard offer a premium typing experience. Log in instantly and securely with the integrated fingerprint reader. With Windows 11 Pro, a 1080p IR camera, and advanced on-device AI, your efficiency and data are safeguarded, making this the ultimate XPS 13 laptop for professionals.
